description: Fen Pall rebuild after wave5a went 0/8 (lantern prop 8/8 from the 'lantern light' style prefix; skull/reaper faces 6/8 fed by the 'shroud' noun; reeds-profile pose produced a standing skeleton-heron). Fixes: tallow-light prefix (the wave-3c lesson), 'shroud' dropped from positives, widow-grade anti-skull block, profile pose moved over open water. Fresh seeds.
style_prefix: hand-painted oil-and-ink creature concept art, muted peat-and-tallow palette, soft charcoal outlines, one warm tallow light in cold fen gloom, grim folkloric, matte painterly texture
